_readme: The text Sarah sees, and how many glowing things are hidden in the world.
`count` is how many there are. Change it and the world places that many —
js/world.js has anchors for up to sixteen, and the extras stack on the last
anchor, so sixteen is the sensible maximum.
What the giraffes say lives in data/npcs.json.

gate.question: You gave me an amulet of what?

intro.title: Giraffe World
intro.body:
The locals have been looking forward to this for ages.

Go and meet them — they could each use a hand with something. Follow the little light if you get turned around.

finale.title: That's everyone looked after.
finale.body:
You did the whole thing — every one of them, all the way up to the top.

I had fun making this. I hope it made you smile.

I love you lots.

— Todd
